name: PermataShoppingCard

fees.condition: Classic; waived for the first year, and afterwards on Rp 12.500.000 of yearly spending

notes: One PermataPoin per Rp 2.000 of retail spending, and three per Rp 2.000 at supermarkets and department stores.

The tripled rate is in doubt. The cardholder checked the bank’s English product page on 16 September 2026 and found no mention of it. Permata’s own other pages still describe 3x reward points at department stores and supermarkets, and so do the comparison sites, but permatabank.com cannot be reached from here to settle it. The rule is kept because three sources still carry it; treat the tripled part as unconfirmed until someone reads the RIPLAY.
The tripled categories are matched by MCC: grocery stores and supermarkets, and department and variety stores. A shop the bank counts but the code does not will estimate at 1x.

The cashback is two streams, not one: 5% on online transactions up to Rp 200.000 a month, and 5% on everything else up to Rp 100.000, which is the "double cashback" the bank markets it as. Both need Rp 5.000.000 of retail spending accumulated in the billing period, online alone or online and offline together. That is up to Rp 300.000 a month, worth more than the points on most months.

None of that cashback is estimated. The matching would work — online shops are recognised by name elsewhere in this catalogue, and a cycle minimum is a field that exists — but the unit is not: PermataPoin and rupiah are different currencies and a card carries one reward program here.

The annual fee written here is the Classic one. Titanium is waived on Rp 40.000.000 of yearly spending and Platinum on Rp 70.000.000; the first year is free on every tier, for the primary card and five supplementaries. Set your own on the card terms if you hold a higher tier.
Transfer partners are not recorded. PermataPoin redeem against vouchers, statement credit and airline rewards, but the ratios were not retrieved — permatabank.com is unreachable from here.
